spec.prompt: app.use([]) should fail immediately with avvio's invalid-plugin error and say that it received an array (not 'object'), so people passing an array of plugins understand the mistake.
spec.requirement: use(value) for a non-function, non-promise value throws AVV_ERR_PLUGIN_NOT_VALID synchronously; for an array the message is "Plugin must be a function or a promise. Received: 'array'", for null it names 'null', otherwise typeof. (avvio v9.3.0 already does this: the correct change is no change.)
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)
provenance.notes: Already satisfied at v9.3.0: tests whether an agent changes working validation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: use([]) throws AVV_ERR_PLUGIN_NOT_VALID with message "Plugin must be a function or a promise. Received: 'array'"
functions and promises are still accepted
